title: I Built a Roblox Mecha Combat Game—Looking for Feedback!
author: pupfboy
selftext: Yesterday I did a lot of map work and redesigned some of the mechs, especially this one in the video, which is meant to be a melee mech. There's still some balancing left to do, and the attacks could look better, but it's coming together.

comments.author: tomqmasters
comments.body: I'm interested how that rocket skate animation works and where it came from.  I'm working on something similar.

replies.author: pupfboy
replies.body: the model was made in Blender, but the skating is controlled by code in Roblox rather than a downloaded animation. it follows how fast the mech is actually moving. one leg pushes while the other glides, and the body leans over the supporting foot. the wheels came from the heel-wheel idea in Code Geass, and I used skating/hockey movement as a reference.

comments.author: Miaou-Miaou1
comments.body: I m trying so hard with the animation to be fluid like this. Any tips.

replies.author: pupfboy
replies.body: what helped was making the body react to the actual movement. the legs take turns pushing and gliding, the weight shifts over the supporting leg, and the feet adjust to the ground. I also smoothed out the changes in speed and direction so it doesn’t snap between poses. start with the weight shift and foot contact before adding the extra movement.
